retired.question: Which Disney animated film was the first to win the Academy Award for Best Original Score?
answers: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs

retained.question: Which 1940 Disney feature won competitive Oscars for both song and score?

rationale: The retained question identifies Pinocchio and its competitive song-and-score wins together. It subsumes the score winner recall; keep the richer paired-award question rather than another Pinocchio award identification.
scope: Retire only the planned ID. Retained questions are duplicate context and receive no new factual approval here.
